evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: The owned/rented contrast appeals to self-origination (autonomy) and positions ownership as the superior good (self-enhancement).

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Framing perspective as a kept asset appeals to self-origination (autonomy) and the durable capability one retains (competence).
